title: Gap frame hydraulic presses up to 4000 KN - Recommendation on preferred capacities and dimensions
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes preferred capacities and dimensions for gap frame hydraulic presses up to 4 000 kN.
clause_3_terminology: Gap frame hydraulic presses up to 4000 KN
Recommendation on preferred capacities and dimensions
Gap frame hydraulic presses up to 4000 KN - Recommendation on preferred capacities and dimensions

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
